notes: Adds opt-in Claude Code and Codex CLI sign-in (both switches default off) and ships the Go 1.27.4 and golang.org/x/net 0.62.0 security fixes, which apply only after a rebuild and redeploy. Existing OAuth, Redis, mailbox state, and configuration remain compatible. Upstream CI and docs workflows changed but the personal updater controls did not; public forks must review and sync the workflow changes before automatic updates resume.
